messages:

Subject: Renewal window + ramp options (multi-year)

Hi Karthik,

We are starting renewal planning for Novara and I wanted to share our goals so you can propose structure options. Key drivers: predictable spend for our finance team, ability to guarantee capacity for our LLM-driven triage workflows, and flexibility to scale faster if adoption spikes.

Current usage snapshot attached (novara-usage-apr2027.csv). We're interested in two broad options: 1) a 3-year ladder with staged token buckets (yearly uplift triggers) and 2) a 2-year flat commitment with a near-term burst runway and quarterly true-ups.

Questions for Redwood:
- Can you outline a ramp schedule with explicit uptake triggers (percentile-based) so our engineering and finance teams can plan?
- How would co-terming work if we align this renewal with a separate data ingestion contract later in Q3?
- We want to avoid automatic renew without a clear opt-out window — is a 60-day opt-out doable?

Would appreciate a short proposal and a call next week to walk through the numbers.

Thanks,
Elena
Director of Product Ops
Novara Health

From: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window + ramp options (multi-year)

Hi Elena — thanks for the context and the usage dump. We ran a quick projection and sketched two concrete proposals (attached PDF): a 3-yr ladder and a 2-yr flat with a burst runway. High level thoughts:

1) 3-year ladder (recommended if Novara wants predictable discounts + runway):
  - Year 1: baseline tokens = current annualized usage, +15% reserved uplift
  - Year 2: auto-uplift to baseline * 1.30 if month-over-month 85th percentile > baseline for 6 weeks
  - Year 3: auto-uplift to baseline * 1.50 with a 90-day notice window to enable provisioning
  - Pricing tiers slide down as you cross uplift triggers (example rates in PDF)

2) 2-year flat + burst (recommended if you want more short-term flexibility):
  - Fixed annual commitment with a 6-month burst bucket available once per year
  - Quarterly true-ups with usage crediting or overage at defined rates

Co-terming: we can co-term the inference contract to Q3 if you want a single renewal date; that will involve a short pro-rata on the first period. We typically do a one-time pro-rate and then normalize to the common boundary.

Auto-renew: we can set a 60-day opt-out window on the hosted contract; for Dedicated/Private deployments legal prefers 90 days, but sales can request exception.

Next steps: Camila, can you attach the billing cadence and a draft timeline? Marissa, please prepare a proposal PDF with explicit token buckets and example invoices. Elena, are you available Thu 5/27 10:00am PT or Fri 5/28 2:00pm PT?

Thanks — happy to walk through live and tune triggers to your ops SLAs.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

Elena / team — adding operational detail so finance has a concrete billing model to review. Draft in the attached spreadsheet (billing-timeline-draft.xlsx). Key execution notes:

- Billing cadence: annual invoice with quarterly usage true-ups (settled as credits or invoice adjustments).
- Trigger mechanics: we suggest percentile-based triggers calculated weekly; a 6-week rolling window before an uplift executes and a 30-day confirmation hold to allow cancellation.
- Provisioning lead time: for Dedicated capacity we require 8 weeks from uplift confirmation; Hosted variants can scale in 48-72 hours with soft throttles.
- Auto-renew opt-out: set to 60 days for hosted; set 90 days on private + a one-time exception field if Novara needs 60 for the whole agreement. Legal will review final language.
- Co-term flow: initial pro-rata invoice to align to chosen fiscal boundary; we recommend aligning to Q3 for minimal proration impact.

Marissa — can you include the pro-rata math example for a mid-cycle co-term (30-day pro-rate) and two example invoices (year1 prorated + year2 normalized)? Priyom — please note any constraints for reserving burst capacity (we need to lock GPU capacity windows).

Elena — happy to take the 5/28 2:00pm PT slot if that works.

Camila Reyes
Senior Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
